notes.title: Early access update 1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, the first update is coming a little late because of the holidays but it's finally here. We're sure you've all beaten your scores a thousand times, now it's time to see how you fare against the world.

Change log:
* Online leaderboards added. The game detects your steam username and it can't be changed in-game. Special characters currently aren't supported and will be removed (we will look into fixing this). Local leaderboards are still here
* Tournament leaderboard added
* Multiplayer tournament renamed to Party mode for clarity. Party mode scores will NOT be recorded
* Party mode leaderboard now shows per game scores as well as the total score
* Slightly modified Cards physics to make it easier to hit the ball back after it bounces off the cards
* Seperate sliders for sound effects and music
* In-game leaderboards panel moved to player's right to make it easier to read the scores
* Forehand location moved closer to the player

Notes:
- Local scores will be cleared because of the addition of online leaderboards
- If the game fails to connect to steam for any reason you can still play offline, except that the scores won't be submitted. If you think everything should be working you can try restarting the game.

If you encounter any problems please let us know on our Facebook page, Community Hub or anywhere else you can find us. Have fun!
